creative_direction.name: Silkscreen Jasmine Corolla
creative_direction.brief: A flat silkscreen poster: one oversized eight-lobed scalloped corolla in pale mint blooms out of a deep gentian field, its hard printed edge passing behind the flacon's shoulders like a graphic halo. No floor, no horizon - pure shape narrative, the matte ink swallowing light so the lacquered mint body and ribbed gold cap own every highlight. The product is lifted into the upper two-thirds and the whole typographic plaque sits in a calm lower band: tracked geometric-sans brand line, the name set wide and centred near band width, a short poppy rule floating between image and text like a print registration mark.
creative_direction.material: flat silkscreen ink on matte card with hard-edge scalloped corolla shape
creative_direction.lighting: perfectly even shadowless frontal illumination, flat graphic ink light with no falloff

background.prompt: Seamless flat silkscreen-printed matte card in deep gentian blue, one oversized hard-edge flat scalloped eight-lobed corolla shape in pale mint centred slightly above middle, perfectly even shadowless illumination, no texture gradients, no objects

spec.lighting: perfectly even shadowless frontal illumination, flat graphic ink light with no falloff
